scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 5359 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
